name: Phantom's Luxury Suite
description: The most expensive haunted room in the hotel, decorated in 'Early Opulent Deceased' style. A four-poster bed floats three feet off the ground because why not. The bathtub is filled with ectoplasmic bath bombs. Paintings of stern ancestors judge your life choices. A spectral fireplace provides ambiance without heat. The minibar contains spirits (both kinds). Room service never arrives, but you still get charged for it.
